summary: Shared ground: lexicon models, identifiers, time, locale and formatting, the sky, preferences, routing paths and the app constants.

src/lib/locale.js.note: Every export is ported. Numbers, dates and times are written from the web runtime's own Intl data (LocaleData+Table.swift, written by ios/parity/locale-data.mjs and held to Node by core.localeData), in English in every region, the only language the web activates. Two branches differ by design: the SUNDAY_REGIONS/SATURDAY_REGIONS fallback, for engines without Intl.Locale weekInfo, is not ported (week starts are weekInfo's, as Chrome, Safari and Node give them); and a tag's -u- keywords (fw, rg, hc, nu) are not read, which no tag the app activates carries.

src/lib/preferences.jsx.note: Everything pure is ported (DEFAULT_PREFERENCES, the choices, readPreferences, writePreferences, applyFormats, effectiveContrast, rootAttributes), and PreferencesProvider/usePreferences are PreferencesModel (@MainActor @Observable, persisted through KeyValueStore, useSkyHour as lookAtClock). Stamping data-* on <html> and <meta name=theme-color>, and the matchMedia queries, are the DOM: VirgaUI applies rootAttributes and skyColor to the scene and feeds the environment's colorScheme and colorSchemeContrast to the model.

src/lib/router.jsx.note: pathParts and hrefFor are ported. usePath, navigate and Link are React and the History API: on iOS the address is the shell's navigation state in VirgaUI (a NavigationStack path, built on Router.pathParts and Router.hrefFor), ported with src/shell.
